title: Scalable Source Selection for Machine Learning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2507.22186v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Given a query table, existing data lake discovery techniques seek to identify data sources related to the query table through schema similarity and joinability. The discovered sources, however, are not always useful for downstream analyses; while some improve task generalization, some have the potential to inadvertently introduce harmful noise or distribution shifts. We formalize source selection as the problem of finding a subset of the discovered sources that maximizes downstream task utility. We propose Splice, a target- and cost-aware source selection system that adopts the idea of gene splicing to identify sources which provide additional signals that the union of all sources misses. To speed up the process, we develop two surrogate variants, Splice-DP and Splice-Grad, that estimate the marginal contribution of subsets to task utility by leveraging data profiles in a meta-learning approach and gradient alignment, respectiv

translated_title: 面向机器学习任务的可扩展数据源选择
translated_abstract: 给定一个查询表，现有的数据湖发现技术通过模式相似性和连接性来识别与查询表相关的数据源。然而，发现的数据源并不总是对下游分析有用；其中一些可以提高任务泛化能力，而另一些则可能无意中引入有害噪声或分布偏移。我们将数据源选择形式化为一个寻找被发现数据源子集的问题，该子集能够最大化下游任务的效用。我们提出了Splice，一个目标和成本感知的数据源选择系统，它借鉴基因剪接的思想来识别那些能提供所有数据源并集所缺失的额外信号的数据源。为了加速这一过程，我们开发了两个代理变体Splice-DP和Splice-Grad，它们分别通过在元学习方法中利用数据画像以及梯度对齐来估计子集对任务效用的边际贡献。
tldr: 提出了Splice系统，一种借鉴基因剪接思想的目标与成本感知数据源选择方法，通过识别能为下游任务提供额外信号的数据源来最大化任务效用，并开发了利用数据画像和梯度对齐的两种加速变体Splice-DP和Splice-Grad。
en_tdlr: Proposes Splice, a target- and cost-aware source selection system inspired by gene splicing that identifies sources providing additional signals to maximize downstream task utility, along with two scalable surrogate variants, Splice-DP and Splice-Grad, based on data profiles and gradient alignment.
